_comment: Atlantis Facility sidecar. The map (atlantis.png) is the CIRCULAR city cropped to its rim; a full-frame seabed backdrop fills the 16:9 behind it so the city reads as nestled in a crater. map_fit shrinks the city below full-viewport fit so it sits inside the backdrop's crater rim (sector polygons scale with it, so they stay aligned). Hex radius is large here because one hex ≈ one room at this zoomed-out scale.
